artifacts.summary: Confirms item 1 (zotero-search.sh quoting gap) and item 3 (deprecated/README.md rationale gap) as real and fixable within file scope; empirically verifies item 2's deploy-hygiene premise is false for old-engine-bootstrapped repos and recommends spinning off a separate deploy-engine task rather than fixing it here.

next_steps: Run /plan 994 to create an implementation plan for items 1 and 3 (script header + agent-exploration.md + literature-agent.md fix, and deprecated/README.md rationale expansion). Item 2 needs a separate follow-up task targeting lua/neotex/plugins/ai/shared/extensions/init.lua's detect_legacy_core before any deploy-headless.sh run against PossibleWorlds or similar legacy repos.

memory_candidates.content: The deploy engine's manager.resync_all/manager.wipe (lua/neotex/plugins/ai/shared/extensions/init.lua) only operate over extensions listed in the ROOT .claude-extensions.json state file, not the per-base_dir .claude/extensions.json. detect_legacy_core() migrates only 'core' from a pre-migration (glob-engine) repo into the new state system; no equivalent exists for other extensions. On a repo bootstrapped entirely via the retired glob engine (no root state file, multiple active extensions), the first deploy-headless.sh (default) silently drops every non-core extension's CLAUDE.md contribution, and deploy-headless.sh --wipe deletes .claude/ and rebuilds nothing. Always verify against a scratch copy before running --wipe on any older downstream repo.

zotero-search.sh requires each query word as a separate shell argument (OR-scored across terms internally); a single quoted multi-word phrase returns zero results even when every word matches individually. Internal callers (literature-discover.sh's tier2_search) already pass an array expansion correctly; the gap is purely in agent-facing documentation for direct/manual invocation.
